data.name: HeroDesc
data.value: Find answers to frequently asked questions about our procedures, clinical safety, and what to expect during your journey at our clinic in Sousse.

data.name: Q1
data.value: Is a consultation mandatory before a procedure?

data.name: A1
data.value: Yes, a prior consultation is essential to evaluate the quality of your skin, discuss your expectations, and ensure there are no contraindications. It allows Dr. Kechida to create a personalized safety protocol for you.

data.name: Q2
data.value: How long do Dermal Filler results last?

data.name: A2
data.value: In general, fillers last between 6 and 18 months, depending on the area treated, the type of product used, and your individual metabolism. Dr. Kechida will give you a more precise estimate during your visit.

data.name: A3
data.value: Most of our procedures are minimally invasive and involve little to no discomfort. For injectable treatments, we use ultra-fine needles and can apply an anesthetic cream if requested. Our laser systems also include advanced cooling technology.

data.name: Q4
data.value: What is the recovery time after a "Liquid Facelift"?

data.name: A4
data.value: One of the key benefits of non-surgical rejuvenation is the minimal recovery time. Most patients can return to work immediately. Slight swelling or minor bruising may occur but usually disappears within 24–48 hours.

data.name: A5
data.value: Please contact our reception directly at +216 23 322 399 to discuss current booking policies and promotional packages available for multi-session treatments such as laser hair removal or skin boosters.
